modelFields.coverageLabel: Published 120-credit named baseline with reviewed outside awards and retained Liberty courses; individual admission and transfer awards remain separate.
rulesNotes: A 120-credit retained-UNIV baseline: 36 unique general education + 12 major foundations + 39 psychology core + 9 Military Resilience cognate + 24 unrestricted free electives.
BIOL 102 and PSYC 101 also satisfy the natural/social science allocations; each course counts once.
UNIV 104 remains three credits. No religion or technology waiver, placement test result, admission, personal award or section availability is assumed.
The major/foundations/cognate denominator is 60 credits. At least one quarter of that component and at least 30 degree credits remain at Liberty.

The selected baseline uses current independently reviewed Sophia and Study.com identities with distinct published Liberty online receiving awards. Conditional additional providers remain separate alternatives.
This undergraduate psychology cognate does not itself establish eligibility for a regulated counseling or psychology license.

unresolved.message: Submit official records for Liberty’s individual transfer evaluation, admission/catalog eligibility, state-specific general-education additions and duplicate-learning review.
Before registration, document accepted prerequisite credit and available online sections. PSYC 491 requires minimum-C prerequisites, junior/senior standing and 18 completed PSYC credits.

obligations.title: UNIV 104 retained
obligations.notes: Three-credit UNIV 104 is retained and 24 elective credits remain within the exact degree’s printed range; no waiver is assumed.

obligations.title: PSYC 491 registration
obligations.notes: Meet the published minimum-C prerequisite grades, junior/senior standing and 18 successfully completed PSYC credits before the online capstone.

gradePolicy.detail: At least C in upper-level courses in the major.

exclusions: The full-time rate requires at least 12 semester credits; eight-week subterms are not separate billing semesters.
Program-specific, military and other eligibility-based rates are outside this standard-rate model.
Technology, completion and course-specific fees remain separate.

publishedFees.label: Online technology fee
publishedFees.eligibility: Standard online fee; waived for actively serving military and their spouses under the published policy.

institutionMinCredits.calculation: 25% of this published degree total must be completed at Liberty.

externalMaxCredits.calculation: Published degree total less the 25% institutional minimum.
externalMaxCredits.scope: Overall outside-credit ceiling only. This does not establish a separate aggregate alternative-credit ceiling or a particular provider award.

majorResidencyBasisCredits.calculation: 12 major foundation credits + 39 psychology core credits + 9 cognate credits, with shared general-education credit counted once.

policyReview.message: The reviewed online undergraduate catalog publishes no separate aggregate alternative-credit ceiling. Its documented overall transfer and degree/major residency rules remain enforced. Each outside course still requires its own published receiving award and provider eligibility; no numeric alternative-credit allowance or student award is inferred.

onlineGuideAwardReview.scope: Exact receiving awards and proposed degree placements only; provider quantities and eligibility remain separate.
